CLI

Here is the complete reference of all CLI commands, arguments, and environment variables across the Kykloi launcher and Python toolchain scripts.

1. Root Launchers (launch.bat and launch.sh)

All arguments passed to the root scripts are forwarded directly into system/launch.py.

Argument / Flag Description
[any launch.py argument] Passed directly through to system/launch.py (e.g. launch.bat --build --clean).
--force-fallback (When using the revised scripts) Bypasses host Python detection and forces extraction and execution of the bundled portable Python archive.

Controlling Environment Variables

Environment Variable Values Description
KYKLOI_FORCE_FALLBACK 1 Forces both .bat and .sh to ignore host Python and unpack/run the offline archive.
KYKLOI_ENCRYPT_KEY <passphrase> Pre-populates the encryption/decryption passphrase for /secure/ documents.
REQ_MAJ 3 (default) Minimum required host Python major version.
REQ_MIN 10 (default) Minimum required host Python minor version.
KYKLOI_LIBC (Linux only) gnu or musl Overrides automatic libc dynamic linker detection on Linux.

2. Vault Appliance Controller (system/launch.py)

Controls the background HTTP server daemon and interactive terminal menu. Can be invoked directly via python system/launch.py [args] or through the root launchers.

Argument Type / Default Description
--build Flag Non-interactive mode. Runs the compiler and immediately exits without starting the web server or interactive menu.
--clean Flag When combined with --build, forces a complete purge of dist/ and the build manifest before compiling.
--password STRING Passphrase used to compile encrypted documents and media in /secure/ directories.
--host 127.0.0.1 Local network interface IP to bind the static HTTP server.
--port 8000 Base port for the web server (automatically checks up to 15 ports if busy).
--verbose Flag Outputs detailed debug-level logs to the console.
--log-file PATH Custom path to write plain-text diagnostic log output (defaults to system/kykloi.log).
-h, --help Flag Shows the CLI help message.

Common Usage Examples

# Start server and interactive menu with debug output
launch.bat --verbose

# Headless clean build with a passphrase (CI or automated backup)
launch.bat --build --clean --password "mysecretkey"

# Host on custom port
launch.bat --port 9000

3. Static Site Compiler (system/build/build_site.py)

The standalone compiler engine. Can be run directly via python system/build/build_site.py [args].

Argument Type / Default Description
--clean Flag Deletes dist/ and .build_manifest.json before building to force a 100% full recompile.
--dry-run Flag Simulates the compilation, encryption, and indexing pipeline without writing any files to disk.
--password STRING Passphrase used to encrypt content in /secure/ directories with pure-Python AES-256-GCM.
--workers CPU Count or 4 Number of parallel worker processes to use for markdown rendering and media encryption.
--verbose Flag Prints granular debug timing logs and worker task transitions.
--log-file PATH Custom log destination path.
-h, --help Flag Shows the CLI help message.

Common Usage Examples

# Test build without writing to disk
python system/build/build_site.py --dry-run --verbose

# Fast parallel clean rebuild utilizing 8 CPU cores
python system/build/build_site.py --clean --workers 8 --password "mysecretkey"

4. Toolchain Verifier (system/tools/verify_manifest.py)

Audits the bundled offline tools in system/tools/archives/.

Command Description
python system/tools/verify_manifest.py Scans all compressed .tar.gz and .zip archives in system/tools/archives/ and validates their SHA-256 checksums against system/tools/tools_manifest.json. Exits with 0 on success or non-zero on mismatch.
